title: Vibrant Light Ethiopian Vegetable Berbere Stew
description: A hearty and aromatic Ethiopian stew featuring a blend of vegetables and spices, served in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Deglaze the pot with the cider vinegar, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew in the agave leaves, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
